```verscript
display "Running injected Python:"
inject python
  for i in range(5):
      print(f"Step {i}")
```

You can inject 'python', 'javascript', 'c', or dynamically evaluate nested VerScript with 'inject verscript'.

  while length(seq) < n

    next_val : seq[last_idx] + seq[last_idx - 1]
    push(seq, next_val)
  reply seq

```
